kbDevkit.metaDesc: Content-addressable task cache, affected package detection, quality checks — one Go binary for any TypeScript/Node.js monorepo.
kbDevkit.commandsFootnote: All commands support --json for scripts and CI
kbDevkit.configLead2: Supports pnpm, npm, yarn workspaces. Inside KB Labs it manages the build of 125+ packages.
kbDevkit.configLead1: Drop devkit.yaml in the repo root. kb-devkit finds all packages automatically and runs tasks in the right order, respecting inter-package dependencies.
kbDevkit.heroDescription: Content-addressable cache, parallel execution, and affected package detection. kb-devkit runs only what actually changed.

commands.desc: Run build across all packages in dependency order. Cached results restore in ~1ms.
Run only on packages changed relative to HEAD, plus all their downstream dependents.
Chain multiple tasks. Each respects its own inputs, outputs, and dep ordering.
Target specific packages by name. Useful for focused rebuilds during development.
Validate all packages against devkit.yaml rules: naming, tsconfig, eslint, deps, structure.
Workspace health score (A–F), issue counts by category, coverage metrics.

features.title: Identical inputs, zero work
features.detail: SHA256 hash of all input files. Cache hit restores outputs in ~1ms. No rebuild, no rerun, no wait.

features.title: Runs in the right order
features.detail: DAG across all (package × task) pairs. Packages with no interdependencies run in parallel. deps: ["^build"] means what it says.

features.title: Knows what actually changed
features.detail: git diff inside each submodule, BFS through the reverse dependency graph. --affected targets only what needs to run.
